      "type": "suggestion",

      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "run a one-month trial period and present a summary of CI failures",
      "quote": "Maybe there can be a one-month trial period and then a summary is presented with all CI failures",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author presented a codex analysis of a month of nightly runs",

      "status_by_id": "c:5511001382",
      "status_by_quote": "I asked codex to take a look at the last months-worth of runs on hebasto's nightly repo"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6829891472",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "unexplained FreeBSD CI failures should be investigated and fixed before adding the job to CI",
      "quote": "There is still a flood of unexplained FreeBSD failures ... I think those should be fixed first",

      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    }
